page.overview:
What is International Philanthropy Federation?

The International Philanthropy Federation, based at the temple of , is purported to be an international charity organization whose goal is to assist the poor. In reality, the organization is a sham, acting simply as a cover for its members to scam vulnerable people into thinking they are helping others.

The International Philanthropy Federation operates under the guise of being a religious group, dedicated to helping the needy. Fittingly, its members don religious uniforms and address their leader as , and their base of operations is referred to as a . They were apparently able to keep the scam going for quite some time, based on how much money the Rocks Pirates were able to steal. It appears to be recognized as a legitimate organization by the World Government and the Marines, as they were quick to send a large fleet to stop the invaders.

At least 42 years ago, the International Philanthropy Federation's temple, Foot Colony, was raided by the Rocks Pirates. Despite their attempts to stop them, the invaders were able to make off with large swathes of cash. Due to the destruction of Foot Colony, the organization's current status is unknown.
